primaryTextChecks.text: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,
primaryTextChecks.decision: Fram calls a skilled and understanding artisan Huram-abi.

primaryTextChecks.text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.
primaryTextChecks.decision: 2:14の代名詞は2:13のフラム・アビを受ける。英文は固定WEBの逐語引用、summaryJaは日本語要約。
